Container.Name: Rotatarr
Container.Overview: Keeps your home screen fresh, for Plex. Shows a random selection of your collections as rows in Recommended and on the home screens, shuffles the row order while keeping built-in rows like Continue Watching on top, and shuffles the titles inside the rows. Seasonal collections (e.g. Halloween only in October), limits per run, Discord notifications and a one-click undo. Works with any collections: Kometa, automatic movie collections or your own.
